name: Alan Wake 2
native_kbm_note: No native keyboard/mouse gameplay support on PS5; not listed among PS5 KBM-supported games (wepc.com list) and official controls are controller-only (source: https://www.wepc.com/gaming/what-ps5-games-support-keyboard-and-mouse/)
notes: PS5 buttons were converted from the Xbox layout (magicgameworld) and checked where possible: dodge L1 (sportskeeda), flashlight toggle Circle and boost R1 (gamerevolution), Mind Place/Writer's Room on the touchpad, right side (gameskinny/sportskeeda). Holding the touchpad opens the map directly, so M also maps to the touchpad. The tool's TOUCHPAD is a generic click and the game expects the right side. Reload Square and inventory Triangle are inferred from Xbox X/Y. magicgameworld lists the PC flashlight boost as 'Mouse wheel'; middle click (MOUSE3) was assumed so it can be held, so verify it in game. Pause ESC is assumed. Not mapped: flashlight battery reload (Q), because its PS5 button is unknown. Dialogue choices 1-3 share keys with quick slots 1-3.
